title: PAF Security Standard Contract (Step 22)
description: Baseline security requirements binding the global non-waivable invariants (tenant_isolation, authentication_authorization_integrity, secret_protection) to concrete controls.

secretHandlingRule.const: Secrets are never committed, never logged, never placed in a configuration surface, and never entered as plaintext by an agent. Injection happens through an unbound interface the agent never reads the value of.

tenantIsolationRule.const: Every canonical data access path must be demonstrably scoped to a tenant boundary. A path whose isolation cannot be demonstrated is treated as a violation, not an open question.
